concept.name: Random search
concept.definition: Hyperparameter search that samples a fixed number of configurations from specified distributions rather than exhaustively enumerating a grid.
concept.intuition: It estimates how a fitted choice behaves on observations that were not used to fit that choice.
concept.mechanics: Specify distributions and a random seed, draw the budgeted configurations, evaluate each consistently, and select by the prespecified score.
concept.failure_modes: Random splitting, overlapping labels, repeated tuning, or an unprotected final test set can produce optimistic estimates.
concept.misconceptions: Validation measures conditional generalization under a split design; it does not guarantee future market performance.
concept.example: Twenty pairs of log-uniform learning rate and integer tree depth are drawn from a space containing thousands of possibilities.
